projects.name: Gourmet Getaway Tours
projects.tagline: Chef-led Hunter Valley food and wine tours, for an Australian client.
projects.problem: The client needed a booking flow that actually converts and a site people could find on search.
projects.whatIBuilt: I built the site end to end, both the customer-facing pages and the booking logic behind them, and moved reservations onto a more reliable booking platform so the flow was smoother. I also handled on-page SEO.
projects.result: More completed bookings, more new customers, and higher search visibility.

projects.name: Oxilia
projects.tagline: An all-in-one workspace where a team chats, plans, and runs projects in one place.
projects.problem: The team was spread across separate tools for messaging, scheduling, and tracking work.
projects.whatIBuilt: I built full-stack features for a single app that brings it together: team chat with channels and direct messages, a shared calendar, project boards, a CRM, video calls, and a visual view of the whole development cycle from request to handoff.
projects.result: Shipped to production and now the team's daily tool, with a mobile version being prepped for the Play Store.
projects.note: Teammate names and chat text in oxilia-workspace.png were already blurred at the source. Verified 2026-09-03; nothing left to redact.

projects.name: MealPlanner
projects.tagline: A meal-planning and nutrition app, built end to end for a client.
projects.problem: The client wanted to plan meals and track nutrition while keeping their data private.
projects.whatIBuilt: I built the full app and its data layer: a dashboard with calories and macros, a meal planner, recipes, a grocery list, and water, exercise, and weight trackers. Daily nutrient goals follow the Philippine national nutrition standards, and the data stays on the phone, with only login going online.
projects.result: Live and in active daily use.

projects.name: Tingi Station
projects.tagline: A neighborhood refill store where you buy staples by the gram, not by the pack.
projects.problem: The store needed an online presence that matched its buy-only-what-you-need idea and made shopping easy.
projects.whatIBuilt: I overhauled the storefront's design and smoothed the whole flow from browsing collections to checkout, including a playful touch where you tap a jar to "fill" it.
projects.result: Live and serving a high volume of shoppers.

projects.name: AiCore
projects.tagline: An offline desktop tool for forensic teams that rebuilds a scene in 3D from scans.
projects.problem: Raw 3D scan data is messy and hard to read, and this has to hold up in a courtroom.
projects.whatIBuilt: I built the frontend and the interactive 3D viewer that turns raw scan data into a clean, navigable model you can move around and measure.
projects.result: A production build now in beta testing with forensic teams.
projects.note: Visual pending: recording a before/after of the 3D reconstruction. Slot in when ready.
